action.instructions: In this racing game, which single input should the driver apply right now?

criteria.accelerate: Accelerate when nothing ahead requires a lower speed.
criteria.brake: Brake before a corner that must be taken slower than the current speed.
criteria.steer_left: Steer left to avoid an obstacle in the current lane.
criteria.steer_right: Steer right to avoid an obstacle in the current lane.
criteria.boost: Use boost on a long clear stretch when a charge is available.
criteria.keep: Keep speed and lane when they are already right.

danger.instructions: If the driver keeps the current speed and lane, how soon does the car crash?
criteria: Safe: no crash in the next two moves.
Threatened: a crash on the second move.
Critical: a crash on this move.

crash_ahead.instructions: If the driver chooses keep, will the car crash on this move? Answer based only on the supplied state.
